title: Circolino Pipistrello plays "The Croco Deal"
description:
A musical-artistic spectacle full of humor, surprising twists and lots of chaos.
A colorful community of fluffy animals lives between containers, boxes and rotten waste. Day after day they lead a contented life in the same rhythm - until an irresistible scent changes everything. As if magically attracted, they follow the scent trail out of their territory and into the big city. But the hoped-for feast isn't waiting there. Instead, they come across dark machinations and a deal that determines who can eat what - and what not. It quickly becomes clear: This is about much more than just food. It's about freedom. 

Box office opening and entrance belt 30 minutes before the show starts

https://www.pipistrello.ch/show/

Exclusive gourmet party – the beginning of extraordinary
location:
Hofkellerei des Fürsten Liechtenstein (Lageplan)
Feldstrasse 4
9490 Vaduz
Fürstentum Liechtenstein, Vaduz
description:
The gourmet party opens the Vaduz Gourmet Festival with nine courses, special encounters and an all-inclusive gourmet experience in the Fürstliche Hofkellerei.

The gourmet festival begins on August 30, 2026 in the special atmosphere of the Fürstliche Hofkellerei Vaduz. At the gourmet party, top chefs from Liechtenstein and Switzerland present their personal signatures and pamper guests with a 9-course flying menu created especially for this afternoon.

Instead of a classic sit-down dinner, guests move between enjoyment stations and stands. Further creations are served via flying service. This creates a lively afternoon with plenty of space for personal encounters and direct exchange with the chefs.

Top chefs from Liechtenstein and Switzerland come together for the menu: Mitja Birlo from “The Counter” in Zurich, Switzerland’s Chef of the Year, and Joel Ellenberger from “IGNIV” Bad Ragaz have each been awarded two Michelin stars and 18 GaultMillau points. Niklas Oberhofer, founder of noEvents and once the youngest star chef in Switzerland, brings his experience from special culinary formats. From Liechtenstein, David Klocksin-Ospelt from “Wöschi” Zurich with one Michelin star and 16 GaultMillau points and Heiko Krüger from “Vivid” Triesen with 14 GaultMillau points are there. Chef pâtissière Franziska Baumann from “The Counter” Zurich provides the sweet highlights.

At the start, guests are greeted with a welcome champagne from Laurent-Perrier. Selected wines from the Fürstliche Hofkellerei and the wine partner von Salis accompany the menu. Further moments of enjoyment are offered by the champagne bar by Laurent-Perrier, a caviar tasting by Oona and beef tartare by Rageth.

At the cocktail bar, Wolfgang Mayer and Silvan Hug from the Widder Bar Zurich team create special signature drinks. “Three for Blues” and singer Janet Dawkins provide the musical accompaniment. Moderator Reto Möhr leads through the enjoyable afternoon.

The ticket includes the entire 9-course flying menu as well as the accompanying wine, champagne, cocktail and tasting offers. The number of places is very limited.

title: Opening of the special exhibition “The Lynx HEIA”
location:
Liechtensteinisches LandesMuseum (Lageplan)
Städtle 43
9490 Vaduz
Fürstentum Liechtenstein, Vaduz
description:
Opening of the special exhibition of the female lynx HEIA

Andrea Kauer Loens, director of the Liechtenstein State Museum, welcomes us. Anna Weber, interim head of the Forest Office; Nature and agriculture speak the welcoming words. Olivier Nägele introduces the topic.

The special exhibition tells the story of the female lynx HEIA - about her way to Liechtenstein, about her territory, about her partners and young and finally about the traces and evidence she left behind. Based on this exciting biography, visitors learn a lot of interesting facts about the biology of lynxes, the state of the lynx populations and their threats and how we can help the local wild cats.

The opening can also be followed via live stream.

title: Vernissage with reading | In the context of the collection: Evi Kliemand
location:
Kunstmuseum Liechtenstein (Lageplan)
Städtle 32
9490 Vaduz
Fürstentum Liechtenstein, Vaduz
description:
A production by the Kunstmuseum Liechtenstein, curated by Annett Höland.

Evi Kliemand (born 1946) is a painter, writer, poet, journalist and art educator.

The exhibition takes the artist's works from the collection of the Kunstmuseum Liechtenstein as a starting point and makes some of her creative phases tangible.

In addition to Kliemand's painting work, his photographic work is present in picture cycles, supplemented by insights into his graphic work. Poetic sequences and poems from the audio book editions make the written work audible. In addition, works from the recent past reveal a multidimensional reality.

In the artist's words: "In search of what is disappearing, what is missing, what has not become visible - what has been passed over and destroyed - by which the senses are touched as those affected, what is perceived at the door. As if she were walking on water, she stood on the shore of her painting.”

A production by the Kunstmuseum Liechtenstein, curated by Annett Höland.

title: Princely Tattoo Parade
location:
Verkehrsfreies Städtle (Lageplan)
9490 Vaduz
Fürstentum Liechtenstein, Vaduz
description:
Around 800 participants in the “Princely Tattoo Parade” delight over 6,000 spectators each - with free entry.

The “Princely Tattoo Parade” has been an important part of the event since “The Princely Liechtenstein Tattoo” was held for the second time. Since 2019 it has been taking place in the traffic-free town of the Liechtenstein capital Vaduz.

The “Princely Tattoo Parade” allows visitors to enjoy high-class formations - with free admission. In addition, the “Princely Tattoo Parade” is a popular and valued platform for youth musicians, music clubs and other Liechtenstein and regional clubs to present themselves to a large audience.

In total, around 800 participants inspire the over 6,000 spectators at the “Princely Tattoo Parade”.

parade
The parade begins at 11 a.m. at the town hall in Vaduz and leads through the traffic-free town to Peter-Kaiser-Platz.

Big finale
As the grand finale of the "Princely Tattoo Parade", all participants form up on Peter-Kaiser-Platz - nestled between the government and state parliament buildings - for a joint open-air concert with brilliant, musical power.

Individual square concerts
Following the official part of the "Princely Tattoo Parade", the participating music groups will perform open-air concerts on Peter-Kaiser-Platz and at several locations in the Städtle.

Alpine descent
The cows from Alp Pradamee are expected to arrive in the Städtle at around 2 p.m.

Catering
There are several drink and food stalls on Peter-Kaiser-Platz.
In addition, the 2026 Gourmet Festival with numerous top chefs will take place at the same time as the “Princely Tattoo Parade” on the town hall square. Further information can be found at https://www.genussfestival.li
